caption: This drawing features the figure of a horse in profile, oriented toward the left side of the composition. The horse is depicted in mid-stride with its front left and rear right legs raised, and its front right and rear left legs extended, suggesting movement. The coloration of the horse is a mottled brown with dark gray or black patches, giving it a weathered, metallic appearance. The mane and tail are simple and stylized, with the tail curving upward and outward. The horse stands atop a narrow, horizontal cylindrical base that runs parallel to the bottom edge of the image. The background is a plain, light off-white or beige color, and there are no additional objects, figures, or scenery in the composition.
